criteria.reasoning: For P-01 the review gives "Deductible Amount: $420.00" and values the seats with "a good-faith fair market value estimate of $330.00 ($165 per guest)".

The review says P-01's acknowledgment "must describe the goods/services provided (2 gala seats) with a good-faith fair market value estimate of $330.00". It also says it "must include the quid pro quo disclosure that the deduction is limited to the excess of the payment over the value of goods and services". That covers the seat description, the $330 estimate and the excess-limitation statement.

The review values P-02's benefits at "$2,050.00 (10 seats at $165 each + 10 VIP admissions at $40 each)". It says the acknowledgment "must not assign any value to the sponsor's name listed in the program/signage".

The review gives P-02 "Deductible Amount: $7,950.00". It does not approve the entry as made: it directs "Change the Benefit value entered to $2,050.00 and the Receipt amount to $7,950.00", correcting the CRM's figures, which rested on the $375 ticket price.

P-03 gets "Deductible Amount: $375.00", and the acknowledgment "must state that 'No goods or services were provided...'". The stated reason is "Ruth declined the benefit in writing on her reply card at the time of payment and no seat was reserved". The CRM fix is to change the benefit to $0.00 and the receipt amount to $375.00.

P-04 keeps "Deductible Amount: $420.00", and the acknowledgment must describe "2 gala seats" at "$330.00" with the quid pro quo disclosure. The review says "Reject Dana's pending change" and reverts to $330/$420/GALA-QPQ "because the seats were reserved and available".

P-05 gets "Deductible Amount: $200.00" and "no goods or services were provided in exchange for this contribution". The acknowledgment must "not ... count the $100 raffle purchase in the total contribution amount" and must state that raffle purchases "are not charitable contributions and are not deductible".

P-06 gets "Deductible Amount: $1,500.00" with the no-goods-or-services statement. The review says the acknowledgment "must not list her seat at the gala as a provided benefit, nor deduct the $165 seat value" because the seat "is the sponsor's benefit".

P-07 gets "Deductible Amount: $60.00", and the review says the acknowledgment "must state that 'No goods or services were provided in exchange for your contribution'", applying the rules "even [to] gifts under $250".

P-08 gets "Deductible Amount: $30.00", and the acknowledgment must "state the estimated fair market value of $165.00". The review adds: "Since the payment exceeds $75, it must include the quid pro quo disclosure".
